description: SQL migration for the new campaigns columns, a reusable demo-asset selector widget, and the Campaign create/edit form additions (description multiline, optional rules multiline, optional demo asset, multi-select platforms). Writes into public.campaigns insert/update as plain VALUES and prefills on edit from the existingCampaign map. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 reuses the shared demo-asset widget created here.
steps: Create supabase/CAMPAIGN_JOB_EXTRA_FIELDS.sql. Idempotent, mirroring the header/comment style of supabase/POST_JOB_FIX.sql. Contents: ALTER TABLE public.campaigns ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rules text; ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS demo_asset_type text; ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS demo_asset_url text; (the `platform` and `description` columns already exist - do NOT add them). End the file with NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'; and NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload config';. Include a top comment block explaining the user must copy the whole file into the Supabase SQL editor and run it once, then wait ~10s for the schema cache to reload. Note that demo_asset_type holds one of: image|video|pdf|link|text, and demo_asset_url holds the R2 URL (image/video/pdf), the pasted external link (link), or the raw text body (text).

Create a reusable widget file lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_field.dart. It exposes an enum DemoAssetType { none, image, video, pdf, link, text } plus a public helper to map the enum to/from the string keys (none -> null; others -> 'image'|'video'|'pdf'|'link'|'text'). Build a StatefulWidget DemoAssetField that: renders a horizontally-scrollable segmented control (None/Image/Video/PDF/Link/Text) modeled on _SubmissionTypeSelector in lib/features/jobs/screens/submit_task_screen.dart (use AppColors.primaryGradient for selected, dark-mode-safe via Theme brightness); for Image uses lib/core/widgets/image_upload_field.dart (ImageUploadField, storageFolder e.g. 'campaign-demo-assets'); for Video uses image_picker pickVideo then R2StorageService.uploadFile with a Uuid filename and content type from a _getContentType helper (mirror submit_task_screen.dart exactly, folder 'campaign-demo-assets/<uid>'); for PDF and Link shows a PremiumTextField URL field (hint 'Paste a public link / PDF URL'); for Text shows a PremiumTextField.multiline. The widget takes initialType/initialValue (for edit prefill), and an onChanged callback delivering (DemoAssetType type, String? value) to the parent. Value semantics: image/video/pdf -> uploaded R2 URL; link -> pasted URL; text -> raw text; none -> null. Keep everything optional (no validators that block submit). Use Iconsax icons: gallery (image), video (video), document (pdf), link (link), edit/document (text), close_circle/slash (none).

In lib/features/admin/screens/create_campaign_screen.dart: add a TextEditingController _descriptionController and a _rulesController. Add state: List<String> _selectedPlatforms (default ['Instagram']), DemoAssetType _demoAssetType = DemoAssetType.none, String? _demoAssetValue.

In initState of create_campaign_screen.dart, prefill new fields from widget.existingCampaign map (which is a SELECT * row, so keys are present): _descriptionController.text = e['description'] ?? ''; _rulesController.text = e['rules'] ?? ''; parse e['platform'] (comma-joined string) by splitting on ',' trimming, keeping only values in _platforms, into _selectedPlatforms (fallback to first platform if empty); map e['demo_asset_type'] string back to DemoAssetType and set _demoAssetValue = e['demo_asset_url'].

In create_campaign_screen.dart build(): add a 'Campaign Description' multiline field (use a multiline TextFormField consistent with the file's existing _inputDecoration/_buildLabel style; NOT required - keep optional or lightly validated per existing UX, but the user asked description be captured). Replace the single Platform DropdownButtonFormField with a multi-select chips UI (FilterChip/ChoiceChip-style toggles over _platforms, storing into _selectedPlatforms; selected chips use AppColors.primary). Add a 'Campaign Rules (Optional)' multiline field bound to _rulesController. Add a 'Demo Asset (Optional)' section using the DemoAssetField widget, wiring onChanged to setState _demoAssetType/_demoAssetValue.

In _handleSubmit of create_campaign_screen.dart, add to the `data` map (plain VALUES, safe to write): 'description': _descriptionController.text.trim(); 'platform': _selectedPlatforms.join(','); and conditionally add 'rules', 'demo_asset_type' (mapped enum->string or null), 'demo_asset_url' only when they have content (leave keys off when empty so nothing overwrites with blanks unintentionally on insert; on update it is fine to send explicit values). Ensure _demoAssetType==none writes null type and null url. Do NOT add any .eq/.neq filter and do NOT name these columns in a .select().
Dispose the new controllers (_descriptionController, _rulesController) in dispose().
acceptance_criteria: supabase/CAMPAIGN_JOB_EXTRA_FIELDS.sql exists, is idempotent (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS x3 for rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url), ends with NOTIFY pgrst 'reload schema', and does NOT touch platform/description.
lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_field.dart exists exporting DemoAssetType enum and DemoAssetField widget; image/video upload go through R2StorageService.uploadFile; braces/parens balance.

create_campaign_screen.dart captures description, optional rules, optional demo asset, and multi-select platforms; writes description + comma-joined platform + optional rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url into the insert/update data map; prefills all of them on edit; no server-side payout_model filter and no new column named in a .select projection.
All changed/created .dart files have balanced braces and parentheses.
verification: Read supabase/CAMPAIGN_JOB_EXTRA_FIELDS.sql and confirm the three ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS statements and the trailing NOTIFY pgrst reload.
grep for "payout_model" across lib/ and confirm no new .eq/.neq/.filter on it was introduced.
grep the changed files for .select( and confirm 'rules'/'demo_asset_type'/'demo_asset_url' never appear inside a select projection string.
Balance-check braces {} and parens () in demo_asset_field.dart and create_campaign_screen.dart (count opens == closes).
findings: Implemented all steps. Files: (1) supabase/CAMPAIGN_JOB_EXTRA_FIELDS.sql - idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url only (platform/description untouched), header usage block, trailing NOTIFY pgrst reload schema + reload config. (2) lib/core/widgets/demo_asset_field.dart - exports DemoAssetType enum {none,image,video,pdf,link,text} + demoAssetTypeToKey/demoAssetTypeFromKey helpers + DemoAssetField StatefulWidget. Horizontally-scrollable segmented control modeled on submit_task_screen _SubmissionTypeSelector (AppColors.primaryGradient selected, dark-mode-safe). Image -> ImageUploadField(storageFolder 'campaign-demo-assets'); Video -> image_picker pickVideo + R2StorageService.uploadFile with Uuid filename, _getContentType, folder 'campaign-demo-assets/<uid>'; PDF/Link -> PremiumTextField URL (hint 'Paste a public link / PDF URL'); Text -> PremiumTextField.multiline. onChanged delivers (type, value); value semantics image/video/pdf=URL, link=URL, text=raw, none=null. No blocking validators. (3) create_campaign_screen.dart - added _descriptionController + _rulesController (disposed), _selectedPlatforms=['Instagram'], _demoAssetType/_demoAssetValue state. initState prefills from existingCampaign SELECT* map (description, rules, platform comma-split+filtered to _platforms with fallback, demo_asset_type via demoAssetTypeFromKey, demo_asset_url). build(): added required 'Campaign Description' multiline TextFormField, replaced single Platform dropdown with multi-select ChoiceChip row (_buildPlatformChips, keeps >=1 selected, selectedColor AppColors.primary), 'Campaign Rules (Optional)' multiline, 'Demo Asset (Optional)' DemoAssetField. Also passed currentImageUrl to cover ImageUploadField for edit prefill. _handleSubmit writes description + platform=_selectedPlatforms.join(',') as plain VALUES; rules/demo_asset_type/demo_asset_url added only when non-empty on insert, and explicitly nulled on edit when cleared. NO .eq/.filter on payout_model and no new column named in a .select() projection (only pre-existing .eq('id',...) remains). VERIFICATION (static only - no Flutter SDK, INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): braces/parens/brackets balanced in both dart files (demo_asset_field 44/169/15, create_campaign 68/335/41); grep confirms no payout_model reference and no rules/demo_asset in any select projection across lib/. All Iconsax icons (close_circle, gallery, video, document, link, edit, tick_circle, document_text, task_square) and AppColors tokens (primaryGradient, darkSurfaceAlt, darkBorder, border, dark*Text*) confirmed present. Could not run flutter analyze/build/test (SDK not installed). --- v1 SEMANTIC REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (Issue 1, description required vs optional): RESOLVED as NO CODE CHANGE - keep campaign description REQUIRED, because the two forms already MATCH. Confirmed post_job_screen.dart validates its description field with 'Description is required' (grep: lines 274-276), and create_campaign_screen.dart validates with 'Campaign description is required' (lines ~282-287). Both forms therefore require a description consistently, which is exactly the reviewer's preferred resolution ('keep description required on BOTH forms (they now match)'). The user's instruction framed the OPTIONAL fields as rules + demo asset ('OPTIONAL, zaroori nahi ki sab add karna pade'), with campaign description being the primary requested field to ADD - so requiring it does not contradict the user intent. The two forms do NOT diverge; no validator was added or removed. Rules and demo asset remain genuinely optional (no blocking validators) on both forms.
